verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question for a SaaS marketing and email platform like Brevo, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or storage location. The IP whitelisting, SFTP sync and security-incident items are about other things and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
